description.zh: 模板ID。可以通过台[智能媒体服务控制台](https://ims.console.aliyun.com/summary)>模板管理>实时转码模板或[创建实时转码模板](~~449217~~)的返回参数中获取。
description.en: The template ID. To obtain the template ID, log on to the [Intelligent Media Services (IMS) console](https://ims.console.aliyun.com/summary), choose Real-time Media Processing > Template Management, and then click the Transcoding tab. Alternatively, find the ID from the response parameters of the [CreateLiveTranscodeTemplate](~~449217~~) operation.
